memory_candidates.content: In this repo's deploy, `.claude/scripts/check-task-references.sh`'s TREE_ROOTS are fixed to `agent-system/extensions`, `.opencode`, `lua`, `.memory` -- it cannot be pointed at README.md, FormalSystem/**, or docs/** (a positional PATH_SCOPE outside those four trees exits 2). When a plan cites this script as the C3 (no-task-number-references) verification mechanism for deliverables outside those trees, run the script anyway for the record (it PASSes trivially, 0 occurrences) but substitute a manual `grep -iE '\btask[ #]?[0-9]'` over the actual diff of the touched files as the real gate.

docs/project-info/implementation-status.md organizes its module tables by directory-derived layer (Layer 1 = Semantics/*, Layer 2 = Metalogic/*, etc.), not by conceptual grouping. When a plan instructs adding a row 'to the Layer N table' for a module, check the file's own layer headers against the module's actual source directory before inserting -- a module under Semantics/ belongs in the Semantics layer's table even if its result is conceptually closer to a Metalogic-layer topic.
